risk_note: RV1 (catalog, agent). ProductCard.price_spec_hint is decided in one pure function (catalog/domain/spec-hint.ts): JD with a sku-mode product_key gives null, everything else spec_uncertain, no price_from this phase (BR-PROD-04, D10-713). The JD mode is read from the card's own product_key shape (jd:i_<n> item, jd:<skuId> sku; BR-PROD-03), never from configuration or union item fields. card-assembler writes it on every card; the Agent search and quote cards copy it (absent is null). No amount, ledger, contract or migration change.
